authority_model.px: defines repository governance, allowed scope, contracts, and validation requirements
authority_model.codex_host: retains native discovery, execution, tool, approval, and security authority

project_default.selection: semantic or exact PX broker query

host_limitation: PX repository policy cannot prevent Codex from directly discovering skills in a user-global .agents tree.

remediation.preferred: A host-supported workspace skill profile or allowlist exposing only project PX facades by default.
remediation.interim: Report the boundary as advisory, require explicit vendor intent, and never claim PX-enforced host isolation.

prohibited_claims: PX blocks direct global skill discovery
global Microsoft or Foundry skills are isolated by PX when Codex enumerates them directly
